STAY FOR THE COUNT – Saturday 16 January 2027

Hawkeye is a free app for Nigerians. It is independent and nonpartisan: not INEC, not the government, not a political party.

Before 16 January:
1. Install Hawkeye Election Monitor or Hawkeye Lite (Google Play or App Store)
2. Verify your number
3. Save your polling unit
4. Do the free practice run

On the day: vote, then stay for the count or come back. When the result is posted, photograph it in Hawkeye and submit. It becomes part of a public record anyone can check. No signal? It sends later.

No result is worth your life. Follow officials' instructions. Never interfere or argue. Photograph only what is posted or handed out.

https://hawkeye.com.ng/stay

KU TSAYA DOMIN ƘIDAYA – 16 ga Janairu 2027

Hawkeye manhaja ce ta kyauta, mai zaman kanta: ba INEC ba ce, ba gwamnati ba ce, ba jam'iyyar siyasa ba ce.

Kafin 16 ga Janairu:
1. Ku shigar da Hawkeye Election Monitor ko Hawkeye Lite
2. Ku tabbatar da lambarku
3. Ku ajiye rukunin zaɓenku
4. Ku yi gwajin atisaye

A ranar zaɓe: ku jefa ƙuri'a, ku tsaya domin ƙidaya ko ku dawo. Idan an liƙa sakamako, ku ɗauki hotonsa da Hawkeye ku aika. Zai shiga littafin jama'a da kowa zai iya dubawa. Babu yanar gizo? Zai tafi daga baya.

Babu sakamakon da ya fi ranku daraja. Ku bi umarnin jami'an zaɓe. Kada ku tsoma baki, kada ku yi gardama. Ku ɗauki hoton abin da aka liƙa ko aka ba ku kawai.

https://hawkeye.com.ng/stay
ig:
NỌRỌNỤ MAKA ỌGỤGỤ – 16 Jenụwarị 2027

Hawkeye bụ ngwa n'efu nweere onwe ya: ọ bụghị INEC, ọ bụghị gọọmentị, ọ bụghị pati ndọrọndọrọ ọchịchị.

Tupu 16 Jenụwarị:
1. Wụnyenụ Hawkeye Election Monitor ma ọ bụ Hawkeye Lite
2. Nyochaanụ nọmba unu
3. Chekwaanụ ngalaba ntuli aka unu
4. Meenụ ọsọ omume

N'ụbọchị ahụ: tụọnụ vootu, nọrọ maka ọgụgụ ma ọ bụ laghachi. Mgbe e gosiri nsonaazụ, seenụ ya foto ma zipu ya. Ọ ga-abanye na ndekọ ọha onye ọ bụla nwere ike ilele. Enweghị netwọk? Ọ ga-eziga ya emesịa.

Ọ dịghị nsonaazụ ọ bụla dị mkpa karịa ndụ unu. Soronụ ntụziaka ndị ọrụ ntuli aka. Unu etinyela aka n'ọrụ ha, unu esela okwu. Seenụ foto naanị ihe e gosiri ọha ma ọ bụ nke e nyere unu.

https://hawkeye.com.ng/stay
yo:
Ẹ DÚRÓ FÚN ÌKÀ – 16 Ṣẹ́rẹ́ (January) 2027

Hawkeye jẹ́ ohun èlò ọ̀fẹ́ àti olómìnira: kì í ṣe INEC, kì í ṣe ìjọba, kì í sì í ṣe ẹgbẹ́ òṣèlú.

Ṣáájú 16 Ṣẹ́rẹ́:
1. Ẹ gba Hawkeye Election Monitor tàbí Hawkeye Lite
2. Ẹ fìdí nọ́mbà yín múlẹ̀
3. Ẹ fi ẹ̀ka ìdìbò yín pamọ́
4. Ẹ ṣe eré àdánwò ọ̀fẹ́

Ní ọjọ́ náà: ẹ dìbò, ẹ dúró fún ìkà tàbí ẹ padà wá. Tí wọ́n bá lẹ̀ àbájáde, ẹ ya fọ́tò rẹ̀ kí ẹ sì fi ránṣẹ́. Yóò di ara àkọsílẹ̀ gbangba tí ẹnikẹ́ni lè ṣàyẹ̀wò. Kò sí íńtánẹ́ẹ̀tì? Yóò ránṣẹ́ lẹ́yìn.

Kò sí àbájáde kankan tí ó ṣe pàtàkì ju ẹ̀mí yín lọ. Ẹ tẹ̀lé ìtọ́ni àwọn òṣìṣẹ́ ìdìbò. Ẹ má ṣe dí wọn lọ́wọ́, ẹ má sì bá ẹnikẹ́ni jiyàn. Ẹ ya fọ́tò ohun tí wọ́n lẹ̀ tàbí tí wọ́n fún yín nìkan.

https://hawkeye.com.ng/stay
